create_multiview_dataset: create a Dataset instance to load synchronized multiview video with tracked mesh data from KRT and geometry directories
load_background_images: load background images for all cameras using ImageLoader with a configurable black level subtraction
get_camera_intrinsics_extrinsics: get camera pose data including position, rotation, focal length, and principal point via get_krt method
subsample_pixel_coordinates: generate pixel coordinates using patch, random, random2, or stratified subsampling strategies for memory-efficient training
standardize_vertices_textures: standardize mesh vertices and texture maps by subtracting mean and dividing by standard deviation
